_comment: Clip-library manifest for the avatar surface. baseUrl is prefixed to every path. 'still' is the pre-clip fallback: one photo of Vintos in the home, shown with a slow breathing scale until real clips exist. Each emote entry has a clip pool (one is chosen at random) and an optional fallback chain ending at idle. Start with only the emotes he regularly uses; every unlisted tag falls back automatically.
